correctness.rationale: Walsh parity gives an exact quartic expansion, and twofold K5 cycle-pair incidence turns its deficit at 32/5 into 90 displayed nonnegative quartic squares. Uniform coefficients have second moment 10 and fourth moment 640, attaining the bound. SOS equality forces uniform absolute coefficients and positive 4-cycle products, precisely cut signings. Sign characters kill off-diagonal Euclidean-form coefficients on averaging, and S5 edge transitivity equalizes the diagonal, so the exact norm ratio is also the true Banach--Mazur distortion. The embedded exact checker confirms 715 rational polynomial coefficient identities, 45 pair incidences and 32 sign maximizers.

value.rationale: The complete 10-dimensional second homogeneous Rademacher chaos is a natural and non-arbitrary Banach subspace. K5 is the first complete graph with each adjacent and disjoint edge pair lying in the same number of 4-cycles; this produces a sharp positive SOS decomposition, a full cut-sign extremizer classification and exact Banach--Mazur distance. The improvement over standard dimension-free hypercontractivity is quantitative and geometrically interpretable, beyond a mere finite test vector or known-table recitation.
